page.title: Matter
page.subtitle: Connection to the Matter sidecar.
page.insecureText: The sidecar is reached over plain http on a non-loopback address. The token travels unencrypted. Use https, or keep the sidecar on the same host.

status.title: Connection status
status.loadError: The status could not be loaded.

hint.not_configured: Enter the sidecar URL and token below to connect.
hint.connected: The plugin is connected to the Matter sidecar.
hint.unavailable: The sidecar cannot be reached. Check that it is running and that the URL, port and firewall are correct. Attraccess retries automatically.
hint.unauthorized: The sidecar rejected the token. Check the token (also after a rotation) and enter it again.
hint.incompatible: The versions do not match. Upgrade or downgrade the sidecar to a supported combination.
hint.misconfigured: The URL, the CA certificate or the TLS setup is invalid. Check the URL and path prefix, and that the CA matches the sidecar certificate.
hint.hostVersion: This Attraccess version does not report its version. Upgrade Attraccess to 1.11.0 or newer.

form.title: Connection settings
form.urlDescription: Use https for anything but the same host. A path prefix for a reverse proxy is allowed.
form.credentialDescription: The shared service token configured on the sidecar. It is never shown again after saving.
form.caDescription: PEM certificate(s) to trust in addition to the system roots, for a private CA.
form.caCleared: The CA certificate will be removed when you save.
form.savedText: The connection settings were saved. The plugin reconnects now.
form.removeText: The URL and token are deleted and the plugin disconnects from the sidecar.
